gran-premio-centroamerica-2023.notes: Website of ICPC Centroamerica (Spanish) as it stood for the 2025 season: dates of the 2025 qualifier rounds, Gran Premio CA of 8 November 2025, a 2025 qualifier results page. Belongs to gran-premio-centroamerica-2025, not 2023. The earlier reader said it belongs to the 2026 edition; our copy shows 2025 dates. Needs a different source for 2023.

sources.evidence: The home page lists the 2025 qualifier dates and the Gran Premio CA of 8 November 2025, the registration page is for the 2025 season, and nothing in the 80 saved files mentions 2023.
